title: Can I ENDURE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans; goal 5 wins, finishes with wins in games 1-4 and 6 (game 5 result unclear - possibly won on the opponent's drawback, 'Wait, did we win?'). G1 Ladies First vs opp Just Passing Through; G2 Alternator vs opp Rook on the Seventh; G3 (white) My Kingdom for a Horse vs opp Conscientious Objectors; G4 Simp vs opp Number of the Beast; G5 Covering Fire vs opp Rook on the Seventh-type; G6 (white) Warlord vs opp Oddball.
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Ladies First - (text not read; queen-related). Just Passing Through - you can't capture on the fourth rank. Alternator - you must alternate between pawn moves and non-pawn moves. Rook on the Seventh - by move 15 you must move one of your rooks onto the seventh rank (2nd rank from black's view). My Kingdom for a Horse - if your opponent captures one of your knights, you lose. Conscientious Objectors - can't capture with pawns. Simp - lose if you have no queen. Number of the Beast - you can't move to the sixth rank. Covering Fire - (text not read). Warlord - at the start of move 12 and onwards your king must not be on your first two ranks or you lose. Oddball - (apparently can't capture pieces on some condition; text not read). Lame Duck.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.
